definitions.explanation: Sturdy boots designed for hiking and mountain climbing, with features like ankle support and durable soles.

examples.japanese: {登山靴|とざんぐつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足首|あしくび}→足首：00918_ashikubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: Hiking boots firmly support the ankles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{登山靴|とざんぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}き→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦{慣|な}らす→慣らす：02390_narasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to break in new hiking boots.

examples.japanese: ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{登山靴|とざんぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧ (mountain climbing) + ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧→ぐつ (shoes/boots)

Note: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧ becomes {靴|ぐつ} (rendaku) in this compound.

TYPES:
- ハイカット (high-cut - for serious mountaineering)
- ミッド⟦カット→カット：10818_katto⟧ (mid-cut - versatile)
- ローカット (low-cut - for light hiking)

FEATURES:
- ⟦{防水|ぼうすい}→防水：06428_bousui⟧ (waterproof)
- ⟦{滑|すべ}り{止|ど}め→滑り止め：27612_suberidome⟧ (non-slip sole)
- ゴアテックス (Gore-Tex)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登山靴|とざんぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧ (to wear hiking boots)
- {登山靴|とざんぐつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}き→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦{慣|な}らす→慣らす：02390_narasu⟧ (to break in hiking boots)
